name: Pawan Panday
summary:
To secure a challenging and rewarding Service Engineer position in a technology-driven
organization, where 4.8 years of experience in the installation, commissioning, and
maintenance of CEMS and CAAQMS can be leveraged to drive service excellence, manage
high-value projects, and lead a high-performing service team. Seeking to progressively learn
and strategically deliver solutions to complex client and business needs
EDUCATION: 1. B.E. — Bharati Vidyapeeth University of (2016 - 2020) [conf 0.55, review=True]
2. 12th — Instrumentation College of Engineering Mumbai Khalsa College (2015) [conf 0.95, review=False]
3. 10th — Matunga Gurunank State Board Sitaram Prakash High Maharashtra (2014) [conf 0.95, review=False]

responsibilities: Service & Technical Expertise: Successfully managed the full lifecycle of complex air quality monitoring projects, including the installation, commissioning, and calibration of advanced Gas Analyzers (Gas chromatography, SO2, NOX, PM, and CO) and weather sensors.

Customer Relationship Management: Provided dedicated technical service and support based on Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) and Comprehensive Maintenance Contracts (CMC), focusing on reducing downtime and ensuring regulatory compliance for key clients.
Problem Resolution: Specialized in advanced troubleshooting and analytical instrument diagnostics to quickly resolve complex analyzer issues, maintaining high levels of system uptime.
Revenue Management: Managed administrative tasks related to service operations, including the submission of monthly and quarterly invoice bills, directly supporting the company's Revenue Growth.

Key Projects and Clients: Managed service and support for prominent environmental projects, including those for the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board, Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, and Century Rayon Grasim CEMS.

Achievements: 1st Rank in Instrumentation Department of whole 4 year of academic.
1st Rank in University Exam During the Academic Year 2017-18
